description: Audita um sistema AI contra as red lines da CAIDP (Apr 2026 UN Global Dialogue submission) + EU-AIA Art. 5 prohibited categories. 7 categorias canônicas: emotion_analysis, biometric_categorization, biometric_mass_surveillance, predictive_policing, child_targeting, social_scoring, subliminal_manipulation. Retorna status (compliant | red_line_violation | requires_review), violations[], jurisdictionsBanning, terminationObligationRecommended. Quando terminationObligationRecommended=true, próximo step é submit_hiroshima_icoc_attestation com attestation_type=red_line_negative ou flag_termination_obligation on-chain (F.2).

aiSystemId.description: sha256 hex (32B) ou opaque ID do sistema AI

prohibitedUseFlags.description: Self-declared flags por categoria red-line. true = sistema realiza essa categoria.

name: audit_ai_red_lines
